title: 第15章 蛇鱼果 下第16章 惊神刺 上
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
山谷嘤嘤，溪水潺潺。
刘信与其他五人聊起下月组队应战之事，林江月本是要走，却留下听了片刻。
“下月我们对战的组有些厉害，他们那儿有个炼气期九层的药师。”
“这次俺本来也请了个厉害药师，奈何临时倒戈，还将俺送的灵石全部送还，看来是前三无望了。”
说到此处，刘信还特意将林江月拉到一边，问她想不想参加，可带她体验一轮。
林江月没有立刻应下，只说自己才炼气期二层够不上。
刘信没有强求，见天色已黑，还主动提出送她回洞府。
他还在路上热情地与她详说组队比试的由来。
“原先许多任务派出炼气期弟子，多少皆有伤亡，后宗主与几位长老商议，开启试炼秘境，所有炼气期四层以上弟子必须参加，否则不能接宗门任务。”
刘信讲完，林江月就着月色打量起他。
从前只觉得刘信粗犷野蛮，今日相处下来，反倒觉得他外拙内秀、心思细腻。
果然看人不能仅凭外貌。
快到山脚林江月发现洞府亮着，正着急要走。
刘信从储物袋拿出灵酒和一挂兽肉让林江月带上。
还嘱咐她若是师父责罚，就说是刘家哥哥非要留吃饭耽误了时辰。
林江月快跑推门进屋，只见张大虎一脸严肃，正襟危坐。
“去哪了？令牌看了吗？天这么黑也不回个话！”
林江月知道是张大虎的关心，一脸的愧疚，随即拿出两坛酒，先给他倒上一杯。
“我有一件事要与师父说，你先喝杯酒压压惊。”
张大虎推开酒杯，双手插在胸前，扭头冷哼一声。

“我今天放了课，被赵真人带到一间别院，他说让我学什么惊神刺，帮他破阵，学会了可赠我一本高阶法术书《赤帝焚天诀》。”
张大虎放下双手站起身来，来回踱步，又搓了搓手对林江月说道“你说什么？赤帝焚天诀？”
“你不会是拿我开涮吧？这本法诀光是复刻一份就要五万下品灵石！”
“不过……我没答应。”
张大虎不可置信地双手拍桌，震得桌子“砰——”一声裂成两半。
“什么！？”
林江月一手把玩酒杯，一手伸进储物袋找来刘信送的《功法选择》来看。
随手翻来却也不见《赤帝焚天诀》这五个字。
心中纳闷只好关上书，接着回答张大虎的疑问。
“他说我可以回来找师父商量，我就回来啦。”
“他还说些什么？”
“说只有一个月时间，学不会就不给。”
“这事师父你怎么看？”
张大虎走到门前，将门关上，又结了一个隔音法阵。
“这件事除了我之外还有别人知道吗?”
林江月摇头。
“那便好，那便好，你明天就去学。”
张大虎脸色一沉，又仰头片刻，接着说道。
“既然事已至此，我不妨与你多说一些。”
“徐子奇师兄有一个妹妹徐子欣与我是同期，有一次赵真人带队外出任务，我、徐子奇、徐子欣、王若兰、秦莲川都有参与。”

“那次任务本来很简单，只是找回人鲛大战中遗落的宗门阵旗。”
“没想到遭遇埋伏，王若兰身死，徐子欣昏迷。”
content_en:
The valleys are roaring and the streams are gurgling.
Liu Xin and the other five people talked about forming a team to fight next month. Lin Jiangyue was about to leave, but stayed and listened for a while.
"The team we will play against next month is quite powerful. They have a pharmacist who is at the ninth level of Qi refining stage."
"I originally hired a powerful pharmacist this time, but he suddenly switched sides and returned all the spiritual stones I gave him. It seems that there is no hope for the top three."
Speaking of this, Liu Xin specially pulled Lin Jiangyue aside and asked her if she wanted to participate and take her to experience it for a round.
Lin Jiangyue did not agree immediately, only saying that she was only at the second level of Qi refining stage and could not reach it.
Liu Xin didn't force her. Seeing that it was already dark, he even offered to take her back to the cave.
On the way, he enthusiastically explained to her in detail the origin of the team competition.
"Originally, many Qi Refining Stage disciples were sent out on many missions, and many of them suffered casualties. Later, the sect leader discussed with several elders to open a secret trial realm. All Qi Refining Stage disciples above the fourth level must participate, otherwise they will not be able to accept the sect's mission."
After Liu Xin finished speaking, Lin Jiangyue looked at him under the moonlight.
In the past, I only thought Liu Xin was rough and barbaric, but after getting along with him today, I found him to be clumsy on the outside and delicate on the inside.
Sure enough, you can't judge people by their appearance alone.
Approaching the foot of the mountain, Lin Jiangyue found that the cave was bright and was about to leave in a hurry.
Liu Xin took out the spirit wine and a piece of animal meat from the storage bag and asked Lin Jiangyue to take it with him.
She also told her that if her master punished her, she would say it was the Liu family brother who insisted on staying for dinner and wasted time.
Lin Jiangyue hurriedly opened the door and entered the house, only to see Zhang Dahu sitting upright with a serious face.
"Where are you going? Have you seen the token? It's so dark and you don't even reply!"
Knowing that it was Zhang Dahu's concern, Lin Jiangyue looked guilty, and then took out two jars of wine and poured him a glass first.
"I have something to tell Master. You should drink a glass of wine first to calm down."
Zhang Dahu pushed away the wine glass, put his hands on his chest, turned his head and snorted coldly.
"After class today, I was taken to a separate courtyard by Zhenren Zhao. He told me to learn the Shocking Thorn and help him break the formation. If I learned it, he would give me a high-level spell book "Red Emperor's Burning Heaven Technique"."
Zhang Dahu put down his hands and stood up, paced back and forth, rubbed his hands again and said to Lin Jiangyue, "What did you say? The Red Emperor's Burning Heaven Technique?"
"You're not making fun of me, are you? Just making a copy of this book costs 50,000 low-grade spiritual stones!"
"But...I didn't agree."
Zhang Dahu slapped the table with both hands in disbelief, causing the table to break in half with a "bang" sound.
"What!?"
Lin Jiangyue played with the wine glass with one hand, and reached into the storage bag with the other hand to look for the "Selection of Exercises" given by Liu Xin.
I turned it over casually but could not find the words "Red Emperor's Burning Heaven Technique".
Puzzled in his heart, he had to close the book and answer Zhang Dahu's question.
"He said I could come back to discuss it with Master, so I'm coming back."
"What else did he say?"
"They said they only have one month, and if they can't learn it, they won't give it to them."
"Master, what do you think about this?"
Zhang Dahu walked to the door, closed it, and formed a soundproof circle.
"Does anyone else know about this besides me?"
Lin Jiangyue shook his head.
"That's good, that's good, you can go learn it tomorrow."
Zhang Dahu's face darkened, he raised his head for a moment, and then continued.
"Now that the matter has come to this, I might as well talk to you more."
"Senior Brother Xu Ziqi has a sister, Xu Zixin, who is at the same time as me. Once, Zhenren Zhao led a team on a mission, and I, Xu Ziqi, Xu Zixin, Wang Ruolan, and Qin Lianchuan all participated."
"That mission was originally very simple. It was just to retrieve the sect's formation flag that was left behind during the Renji Battle."
"I didn't expect to encounter an ambush. Wang Ruolan died and Xu Zixin fell into a coma."
